verses.en: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi i le ie uli, ma le pāuli, ma le múmú, o ie o mea e fai au le tapuaiga e auauna ai i le mea paia; ua latou fai ai foi ofu sa mo Arona, faapei ona poloai mai ai o le AL ia Mose.

verses.en: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e ia o le efotai le auro, ma le ie uli, ma le pàuli, ma le mumu, ma le ie vavae ua milo ona manoa.

verses.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
verses.sm: Ua latou tu°itu‘i i le auro ina seia salafalafa ma manifinifi, ua selescle ai e fai ma manoa, ina ia lalaga i le ie uli, ma le pauli, ma le mama, ma le ie vavae i le galuega a le tufuga poto.

verses.en: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai ai foi ona tau'au ua O ofu sa mo le au faitaulaga faasooina ai, ua faasooina i ona tafatafa e lua.

verses.en: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: O ia lava mea na fai a‘i le fusi faalanu eseese o lona efota, e i ona luga, e pei o le galuega e i ai, o le auro, ma le ie uli, ta le pāuli, ma le mumu, ma le ie vavae ua milo ona manoa, e pei ona poloai mai ai le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua latou teu foi maa soama ua faamauina ai i taai auro, ua togitogiina ai o igoa o atalii o Isaraelu, e pei o le togitogiga o le faamaufaailoga.

verses.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua ia tuuina ai foi ia maa i tau‘au o le efota, o maa e manatuina ai le fanauga a Isaraelu, pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi le ufifatafata i le galuega a le tufuga poto, e tusa ma le galuega o i le efota, i le auro, ma le ie uli, ma le páuli, ma le múmú, ma le ie vavae ua milo ona manoa.

verses.en: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia faatafafa, ma ua faasautualua le ufifatafata; o le aga e tasi lona umi, ma le aga e tasi lona lau, ua faasautualua.

verses.en: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
verses.sm: Ua latou faamau foi i ai o atu maa e fa, o le atu maa, o le salikea, ma le topasi, ma le pereketa; o le atu maa muamua lea.

verses.en: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.sm: O lona atu lua, o le nofeka, ma le safaira, ma le ialoma;

verses.en: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.sm: o lona atu tolu foi, o le lesema, ma le sevo, ma le aselama;

verses.en: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.sm: o lona atu fa foi, o le tasesa, ma le soama. ma le iasepi; ua faamauina lava ia i le taai auro io latou tuugamaa.

verses.en: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.sm: Ua vatusa foi ia maa ma igoá o atalii o Isaraelu, ua sefulu ma le lua, e tusa ma o latou igoa, pei o le togitogiga o le faamaufaailoga, e taitasi ma lona igoa, e tusa ma itu aiga e sefulu ma le lua.

verses.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi i luga o le ufifatafata o filifili auro lelei e tutusa, o le galuega faafilifili uamea.

verses.en: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi taai auro e lua, ma mama auro e lua, ua tuuina foi ia mama e luai pito e lua o le ufifatafata.

verses.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuuina foi ia filifili auro e lua i mama e lua i pito o le ufifatafata.

verses.en: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.sm: O pito foi e lua o filifili auro e lua, ua latou faamauina i taai e lua, ua tuuina foi i tau‘au o le efota i ona luma.

verses.en: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e i latou o mama auro e lua, ma tuuina i ona pito e lua o le ufifatafata, i lona tafatafa lava o loo faasaga i le efota i totonu.

verses.en: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi o isi mama auro e lua, ma latou tuu ai i itu e lua i lalo o le efota, e lata ane i lona itu i luma, e felatai ma le mea e faasoo ai i luga o le fusi faalanu eseese o le efota.

verses.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua latou nonoa foi le ufifatafata i ona mama, i mama o le efota i le manoa uli, ina ia i luga ae o le fusi faalanu eseese o le efota, ina neʻi te'a ese le ufifatafata i le efota; faapei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi le ofu talaloa o le efota, ua atoatoa i le ie uli ua lalagaina.

verses.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.sm: Ua i ai foi i le ofu talaloa se ua i totonu, e pei o le ua o le ofutau, ma le mea na afei faataaliolio ai le ua ne‘i masae.

verses.en: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi i tafatafa o le ofu o rimoni i le ie uli, ma le pāuli, ma le mumu, ua milo ona manoa.

verses.en: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi tagitagi i le auro lelei, ma tuuina i va o rimoni i le tafatafa o le ofu, ua faataaliolioina ai i le va o rimoni;

verses.en: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: o le tagitagi ma le rimoni, o le tagitagi ma le rimoni i tafatafa o le ofu talaloa, o loo faataaliolioina ai, ina ia auauna ai; faapei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi ofu tino i le ie vavae ua lalagaina, mo Arona atoa ma ona atalii;

verses.en: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.sm: ma le pulou o le ie vavae, ma pulou matagofie o le ie vavae, ma ofuvae i le ie vavae ua milo ona manoa;

verses.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: ma le fusi i le ie vavae ua milo ona manoa, ma le ie uli, ma le páuli, ma le mumu, o le galuega a le tufuga fai ie lanu eseese; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi le mea pupula i le pale paia i le auro lelei; ma latou tusi ai le upu, pei o togitogiga o le faamaufaailoga, E PAIA I LE ALII.

verses.en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuu foi i ai le manoa uli, e faamauina ai i luga ile pulou; c pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.sm: Ona uma lea o Je galuega uma lava o le malumalu o le falc fetafai O le faapotopotoga; ua faia foi e le fanauga a Isaraelu e pei o mea uma na poloai mai ai le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea lava ona latou faia.

verses.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.sm: Ua latou avane foi le malumalu ia Mose, o le fale fetafai ma ana mea uma, o ona faamau, ma ona laupapa, o ona faalava, ma ona pou, ma ona lago;

verses.en: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.sm: ma le ufiufi o paíu mamoe poa ua faalanu ulaula, ma le ufiufi o pa'u takesa, ma le ie puipui e ufiufi aʻi;

verses.en: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.sm: o le atolaau o le tulafono ma ona amo; ma le nofoa o le alofa;

verses.en: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.sm: o le laoai ma ana mea uma, ma le areto e laulauina i luma;

verses.en: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.sm: o le tuugālamepa auro lelei ma ona lamepa, o lamepa e teuteua ia lelei, ma ana mea uma, atoa ma le suāuu e mu a“ le afi;

verses.en: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.sm: ma le fata auro, ma le uu e faauu a'i, ma mea manogi e mu, ma le ie puipui mo le faitotoa o le fale fetafai;

verses.en: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.sm: o le fata “apa memea, ma lona taigaafi “apa memea, o ona amo, ma ana mea uma, o le tanoa e mulumulu ai ma lona tulaga;

verses.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.sm: o ie puipui o le lotoá, o ona pou ma ona lago, ma le ie puipui mo le faitotoa o le lotoá, o ona maea ma ona faamau; atoa ma mea uma lava e fai a4 le sauniga o le malumalu mo le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.sm: O ie o mea e fai a'i le tapuaiga i le mea paia, atoa ma ofu paia mo le ositaulaga o Arona, ma ofu O ona atalii e fai ai le faiva o ositaulaga;

verses.en: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.sm: ua faia e le fanauga a Isaraelu le galuega uma lava, a pei o mea uma na poloai mai ai le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.sm: Ona vaavaai lea o Mose i le galuega uma lava; faauta lava, ua latou faia e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII, ua faapea lava ona latou faia; ona faamanuia lea o i latou e
